items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: Interviewer mentions Sam Woodyard in the context of a tour where Lawrence Brown was playing, but Lawrence Brown does not confirm a personal relationship or direct interaction with Woodyard, only discussing the replacement drummer.

ctx.x: Oh, we had -- we were supposed to go back to -- what's that little country -- Greece and places. We probably had a couple of weeks more, but they cut it right off.

Was that the tour that, you know, Philly Piddleby Joe Jones played drums briefly with the band (unintelligible)? I know it was European tour where Sam Woodyard got sick and Philly Joe was brought in. one you were playing on (unintelligible) Joe Jones.
Yeah, Philly Piddleby -- for a hot minute -- Philly Piddleby Joe, or Joe Jones?
